Position: SAP Technical Consultant
Requirements:
- B.Tech/B.E. in Engineering or Computer Science
- Minimum 3 years of SAP development experience
- Must have in-depth skills in SAP, SAP ABAP, SAP ERP, and SAP HANA
- Experience developing reports, interfaces, conversions, and enhancements (RICEFW)
Nice to have:
- Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP FICO, or SAP MM is a plus
- Knowledge of OData services and SAP Fiori is preferred
